commonInvariants: no closed loop and no branch topology
visible internal deformation changes over the frozen horizon

briefs.intent: An open filament with a strongly off-center amplitude envelope; the active mass should feel biased rather than mirror-symmetric.
An open filament with a moving cancellation node: one quiet point should migrate while both sides remain active.
A two-scale filament: a coarse traveling wave carries a finer counter-moving corrugation with visibly uneven strength along the axis.
specificInvariants: coarse and fine scales both visible
fine scale is not spatially uniform

briefs.intent: A persistent asymmetric S-like backbone carrying a finer traveling ripple; the backbone must not flatten during the horizon.
A filament with a moving kink or sign-change region superimposed on a traveling wave, without breaking continuity.
An end-weighted filament whose outer regions carry more transverse motion than the middle, plus a smaller global wave.
A filament with a deliberately quiet waist and active ends; the center should remain calmer without splitting the line.
A filament whose visual energy slowly transfers from one side to the other while the traveling wave continues.
specificInvariants: left-right amplitude balance changes over time

briefs.intent: A broad curved spine carrying a localized packet of high-frequency motion that travels along it.
A beating filament built from nearby spatial frequencies so a slow envelope appears without closing the topology.
specificInvariants: no single rigid traveling sine dominates

briefs.intent: A chirped filament whose local wavelength changes substantially from one end to the other while the phase travels.
A slowly bent backbone carrying a much finer traveling corrugation; both structural scales should remain legible.
